sections.name: DeleteAccount
sections.title: Account deletion form
sections.what: The form where a person deletes their account. The delete button stays disabled until they type DELETE exactly, and a warning explains that deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.
sections.why: Likely reason: deletion cannot be reversed, so the form requires a typed confirmation before it sends anything.
sections.watch_out: If the request fails before a response arrives, the busy flag is never cleared and the button stays stuck, because the request has no error handling.
